Verified GET /api/worlds lists world_1 (size 400, OPEN, 100 slots) and world_2 (size 600, OPEN, 100 slots); chunk API bounds are correct — world_2/map/chunk/18/18 → 200 with 32*32 terrain_b64 + sentinels[] + territory[]; world_2/map/chunk/19/0 → 400 CHUNK_OUT_OF_RANGE; world_1/map/chunk/13/0 → 400 CHUNK_OUT_OF_RANGE. (3) world-enter-world_1 → daily-close → map-center-home-button → 2 zoom-in → HUD reads '7,189 · +15' (adjacent to home 6,188), the 4 Sentinelle towers (yellow torches on stone) are visible around Casa Demo L10 castle with the neighboring Casa Demo L10 at 5,183 also on-screen, and the yellow territory border forms a single closed square around the castle+sentinels — NO cross-shape, matching the wedge acceptance. (4) Console: zero page errors, zero non-whitelisted console errors during the full session (only textShadow/shadow* deprecation warnings, whitelisted per request).
